title: Timing: Maximum of Eight
constraints: `x` packs eight unsigned 8-bit values: element i is `x[8*i+7 : 8*i]`.
`max` is the largest element and `idx` its index. On ties, the **lowest** index wins.
Timing budget: at most **40 logic levels**. A linear scan takes about 84.
hints: A running-maximum loop puts 7 compare-and-select stages in series.
Compare in pairs: 4 winners, then 2, then 1. That is 3 stages instead of 7.
Carry the index along with each winner, and prefer the left (lower-index) operand when values are equal.
